claims.text: Chairman of the Committee on Oversight and Accountability at the 26 July 2023 hearing and of the Committee on Oversight and Government Reform at the 9 September 2025 hearing; appears in the printed member roster of both.

On 11 February 2025 announced the establishment of the Task Force on the Declassification of Federal Secrets under Rep. Luna, and joined her in letters to Rubio, Hegseth and Ratcliffe requesting a briefing on all UAP-related records in their possession.

With Rep. Burlison, launched the House Oversight probe into missing and dead scientists on 20-21 April 2026 after the disappearance of Gen. William Neil McCasland, requesting briefings from the FBI, the Department of War, NASA and the Department of Energy by 27 April 2026.

label: James Comer Jr.
narrative: Comer holds the gavel and therefore the subpoena. He authorised the 26 July 2023 subcommittee hearing and appeared at it, authorised the 13 November 2024 joint subcommittee hearing, and on 11 February 2025 created the Task Force on the Declassification of Federal Secrets and installed Anna Paulina Luna as chairwoman. He joined Luna in letters to Secretary of State Marco Rubio, Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth and CIA Director John Ratcliffe requesting a briefing on all UAP-related records in their possession. In April 2026 he and Eric Burlison opened the committee's investigation into the deaths and disappearances of scientists tied to sensitive US research, triggered by the vanishing of retired Air Force Gen. William Neil McCasland, and demanded briefings from the FBI, the Department of War, NASA and the Department of Energy by 27 April 2026. Burlison told The Hill in March 2024 that he already had Comer's support for a UAP select committee. What Comer has not done, across three years and three hearings, is issue a UAP subpoena - which is the fact the coverup strand records about him.
